name: vecna
lore:
The Whispered One defies the natural cycle of life and decay. He is an apex predator of the metaphysical, a lich-god who draws sustenance not from flesh, but from the hoarded secrets of fallen empires. Vecna occupies no single lair; he haunts the liminal spaces between planes, weaving a web of influence that spans eons. 

His behavior is marked by a terrifying, glacial patience. He does not strike with animalistic fury, but with the surgical precision of a grandmaster. To Vecna, an adventurer is not a threat, but a misplaced variable in a cosmic equation he solved centuries ago. He watches through the eyes of a thousand puppets, his presence a cold, intrusive pressure in the back of the mind. Should you hear his name on the wind, know that your fate was likely sealed before your ancestors drew their first breath.
